about.title: About
about.body: Evil Town is a roleplay experience built around immersive stories, meaningful interactions, and a living city where every player can create their own path.

f1.title: Immersive Roleplay
f1.body: An immersive roleplay experience built around story, choices, and interaction.

f2.title: Unique Experience
f2.body: A different kind of roleplay experience, shaped to make every story stand out.

f3.title: Custom Systems
f3.body: Custom-built systems designed to support and deepen the way you play.

f4.title: Active Community
f4.body: A community focused on interaction and building better stories together.

step1.title: Join Discord
step1.body: Join the official Evil Town Discord

step2.title: Activation Request
step2.body: Submit an activation request, write your ID name, and wait for review

step3.title: Create Your Identity
step3.body: After approval, create your identity and prepare your character

step4.title: Enter Evil Town
step4.body: Enter the city, start your journey, and create your story

q1.a: Evil Town is a roleplay experience where players can create their own stories and live their own path inside the city.

q2.q: How Can I Join Evil Town?
q2.a: Join the official Evil Town Discord to get the latest information about joining the city.

q3.q: Where Can I Find Evil Town Updates?
q3.a: All official announcements and updates will be shared through the official Evil Town channels.

q4.q: Is Evil Town Available To Everyone?
q4.a: Information about access and availability will be announced through the official Evil Town channels.

q5.a: Join the official Evil Town Discord for support and community assistance.
